v: strI 6 ta॰ । 1 puruzasaMjYAyAM pumAMsamAKyAti A + KyA--ka । “jAtiBedAH pumAKyASca” amarokte 2 puruvAcakaSabde pu॰ ।
m: पुम्—आख्या f. a name or designation for male beings, L.; Pāṇ. iv, 1, 48, Sch.
पुम्—आख्य mfn. designated as male or masculine, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 6, Sch.
पुम्—आचार m. the custom or usage of men, Pāṇ. viii, 3, 6, Sch.

k.v: मनुष्या मानुषा मर्त्या मनुजा मानवा नराः। स्युः पुमांसः पञ्चजनाः पुरुषाः पूरुषा नरः॥

s: [s] puM, (pAti rakzatIti । pA + “pAterqumsun .” uRA॰ । 4 । 177 । iti qumsun । qittvAt wilopaH .) manuzyajAtipuruzaH । tatparyyAyaH । paYcajanaH 2 puruzaH 3 pUruzaH 4 nA 5 । ityamaraH । 2 । 6 । 1 ॥ (yaTA, -- “svadeSajAtasya janasya loke guRADike puMsi BavatyavajYA । nijANganA yadyapi rUparASistaTApi puMsAM paradAracezwA ॥” ityudBawaH ॥) mabuzyajAtiH । iti keciditi BarataH ॥ puMliNgamAtraYca ॥ (kUwasTapuruzaH । yaTA, vizRupurARe । 1 । 1 । 2 । “sadakzaraM brahma ya ISvaraH pumAn guRormmisfzwisTitikAlasaMlayaH । praDAnabudDyAdijagatprapaYcasUH sa no'stu vizRurgatiBUtimuktidaH ॥” “akzaramiti vikAraM nirAkaroti pumAn kUwasTaH .” iti tawwIkAyAM SrIDarasvAmI ॥)

m: पुम्—भाव m. the being a man, manhood, masculine gender, Daś.
पुम्—भूमन् m. a word of the masc˚ gender in the pl. number, L.

v: strI pumAMsamanuruDya jAyate “anO karmaRi” pA॰ (anupUrvAjjaneH karmaRyupapade qaH syAt) amu + jana--qa purmAsamanuruDya jAtA pumanujA” si॰ kO॰ । “iha janiH sakarmakaH anuroDaviSizwajananavfttitvAt” tattvakO॰ pardAntatvena antyalopaH । puruzAnantarajAtAyAM BaginyAm ।
m: पुम्—अनुजा f. ‘born after a male child’, having an elder brother, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 100, Kāś. (cf. पुंसानुज).
पुम्—अर्थ m. the aim of man (-ता f.), TBr., Sch.
पुम्—अर्थम् ind. for the sake of the soul, KapS.

v: pu॰ pAti pA--pAlane “pAterqumasun” uRA॰ qumasun । 1 puruze 2 manuzyajAtimAtre ca amaraH । sattvapraDAnatriguRakArye SabdasaMskAraviSezayukte Sabde ca । sarvanAmasTAne pare asun pumAMsO pumAsa ityAdi samAse padAntatve ampare Kayi pare ruH tasya ca saH । puMskokila ityAdi । bahubrIhO uraHpaBftitvAt nityaM kap । sa puMskA apuMskA ityAdi ।

m: पुम्—मन्त्र m. a magical formula regarded as male, Sarvad.
पुम्—मृग m. a male antelope, Mahīdh.
पुम्—पशु m. a man as sacrificial victim, Kathās.
पुम्—प्रकृति f. the nature or character of a man, Var.
